messages:
nina: FYI we just received a vendor-risk packet request from NorthbridgeVendor. They want a focused IAM bundle for their SIG review (SAML/SSO, MFA, RBAC, service accounts). Need to turn around by COB Thursday.

ev an: I can assemble the SAML artifacts (SP metadata, ACS URL, cert fingerprint) and grab Okta screenshots. Which environment? prod.

lee: Ieat: I'll handle RBAC export and a compact least-privilege narrative. I have the role->permission dump in CSV, will redact internal-only roles and map to customer-facing capabilities.

security-bot: Reminder: scrub PII and tenant IDs. Attach sanitized files only.

nina: Also ask from their security team: evidence that MFA is enforced for console logins and for token issuance flows. They explicitly asked for conditional access examples and a short audit sample.

evan: For MFA: Okta policy screenshot + a CSV of MFA events (last 14 days) with only event type + timestamp + user-hash. No raw phone numbers or emails.

lee: For service accounts they want scopes and rotation cadence. We use scoped service principals with 90-day default expiry and short-lived token exchange for elevated ops. I'll add a one-page diagram.

nina: Good. Also include session timeout and max session duration for issued tokens. Northbridge wants to confirm idle and absolute session limits.

lee: I'll include these settings: interactive session timeout = 8h, absolute session = 24h, API token TTL = 15m for short-lived STS tokens, refresh window documented.

legal: Quick note: any PII or customer names in screenshots require a DPA addendum. If they're only validating controls, sanitized artifacts are fine. We can sign the standard DPA.

nina: Thanks @legal. Would you sign the DPA by EOD Thursday if we send it?

legal: Yes, we can expedite provided the SOW/PIP terms don't request changes to data residency.

security-bot: Upload policy: use the secure drive folder and mark access limited to the review group.

evan: Uploaded to secure drive: https://drive.company/northbridge-iam-packet/ (sanitized link). Files: sp_metadata.xml, okta_policy_mfa.png, sp_cert_fingerprint.txt.

lee: Uploaded role_matrix_redacted.csv, rbac_examples.tf, service_account_scope_list.md, session_timeout_summary.txt.

nina: Drafting a 2-paragraph cover note for them. Please keep it non-technical: one sentence about SSO+MFA, one about RBAC & least privilege, one about token/session controls and where artifacts are. Post here when done.

lee: Cover note suggestion: "Redwood requires IdP-managed SSO (SAML) with enforced MFA and conditional access; role-based access controls ensure users and service principals have narrowly scoped permissions; session and token lifetimes are conservative and auditable. Attached are the SAML metadata, policy screenshots, RBAC matrix, and token audit samples for verification."

nina: Slight tweak to mention audit: "...conservative and auditable (logs attached)." Looks good.

legal: Approve sending the DPA to their legal contact if they request it.

nina: OK sending packet + DPA offer now. Scheduling a 30-min sync next Tue for walkthrough. If they request deeper logs, well follow standard redaction procedure and route to security for approval.

evan: One last note: their security asked whether we support attribute mappings for group-based entitlements. I included an example attribute map in sp_metadata.xml and an example SAML attribute snippet in attribute_mapping.txt.

lee: Closing this thread once they acknowledge receipt. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
